title: Nereden Çıktı Bu Zorba Canavar?
author: Rıfat Batur
description: A child cannot understand what is happening: a dear friend is gone, and in his place appears a green creature with feathers, long ears, fangs, and orange horns. The story gives the child a vivid way to recognize and understand bullying behavior.
english_title: Where Did This Bully Monster Come From?
